audience: UK employers and HR or payroll teams that run time and attendance in Chronicle Online

useCases.title: Find late clock-ins for a date range
useCases.text: List the real clockings and the scheduled shifts for a date range. Ask the assistant which employees clocked in late, and by how many minutes.

useCases.title: Review absences booked in a period
useCases.text: List the absence types, then the absences booked in a period. Check the absentee records to see the absence taken per employee.

useCases.title: Check overtime before payroll
useCases.text: List the daily and weekly overtime per employee for a date range. Use the work records to check the worked time behind each figure.

useCases.title: Plan staff cover from the shift rota
useCases.text: List the shift patterns and the shifts scheduled to employees between two dates. Group the staff by cost centre to see each team's cover.

useCases.title: Report on leavers by cost centre
useCases.text: List the employees who have left, and the cost centres used to group them. Use the result for a leavers report by team.
